// REQ: LANG-871 LANG-872 LANG-873 LANG-874
module main

import os

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
struct Point {
mut:
	x int
	y f64 = 1.5e3
}

fn greet(name string, times int) string {
	mut text := ''
	for _ in 0 .. times {
		text += 'Hello, ${name}! $times\n'
	}
	return text
}

fn main() {
	raw := r'C:\temp\$name'
	c := `x`
	p := Point{x: 0x1F}
	if p.x > 0 && !false {
		println(greet('v', 2) + raw + c.str())
	} else {
		panic('never')
	}
	args := os.args or { [] }
}
